scope: Independent source review of auth hook, storage/session implementation, native broadcast transport, sidepanel and popup consumers, and regression assertions; no test, build, browser, or network write in this lane.

verdict_a_live_acceptance.evidence: docs/stabilization/runs/auth-native-observation.json records two full native Chrome reloads retaining admin and selected organization for 553bad3; 824a4b4 has no native observation.

verdict_b_engineering.reason: The positive broadcast path validates canonical storage, but the negative path still trusts a potentially delayed message and can leave valid newer credentials falsely classified as guest.

prior_finding_1.evidence: src/hooks/use-auth.ts:195-202 treats positive broadcasts as invalidation and calls readCanonicalSession; failed restore or mismatched/unverified identity stays guest. src/hooks/use-auth.entrypoints.test.tsx:90-115 covers failed restore and stale positive delivery.

prior_finding_2.evidence: src/hooks/use-auth.ts:221-233 validates the interactive result against restored session and verified subject before broadcasting; entrypoints.test.tsx:68-88 covers failed installation while preserving stored profile.

prior_finding_3.evidence: src/lib/supabase/queries.ts:105-119 returns null on role read error; src/hooks/use-auth.ts:127-144 distinguishes unavailable from false and shows a retryable warning through AuthGate; entrypoints.test.tsx:117-136 covers recovery.

new_finding.title: Delayed sign-out broadcast can demote a newer signed-in session
new_finding.evidence: src/hooks/use-auth.ts:189-194 immediately applies payload.user === null with no canonical reread. src/lib/messaging/native.ts:119-145 broadcasts asynchronously to other contexts. If context A clears old credentials and emits sign-out, context B commits a newer sign-in before receiving A's delayed message, B's receiver becomes guest despite valid current credentials. The positive-message tests do not cover this inverse order.
new_finding.repair: Treat negative broadcasts as canonical invalidation too; reread current storage with generation protection and prove delayed old sign-out after newer sign-in does not leave guest state.

test_evidence: auth-entrypoints-red-001 records 5 pre-repair failures; earlier auth-classification-green-001 records 37/37 for 553bad3. The owner's current combined 9-file run was in progress at review start and is not claimed as passing here. Unit mocks do not prove native timing.
